question: After the integrated arm has learned and edited its connections throughout life, where is the changed behavior expressed?
subject: Joint arm of the fresh confirmation with the common learning rate chosen on full joint development behavior. Use all selected groups, rules and life roots without further selection.
changes: At the endpoint only, either restore the two motor readout arrays, restore sensory input projection/bias and independent raw recurrent coefficients, or both. On the final support, surviving edge generations are restored to their own birth values; regrowth of an old address counts as a new generation. Keep the post-life topology, state, indegree, probes and physical noise the same. No intervention or parameter freeze during learning.
scores: 20 ordered odor choices forked anew from each saved state. Movement is scored by actual contact, tastes are silent; timeouts are incorrect. Stable and return use A truth, reversal uses B truth.
inference: Horizontally pair arms within every life and probe root, then average the three tasks and 20 cells. Crossed bootstrap the eight optimization groups and 16 paired life/probe roots (20000 draws, seed 190397), Bonferroni across the six intact-minus-motor/core contrasts. This is a diagnostic of post-learning expression. Replacing coadapted pieces can impair action even if neither piece is independently sufficient for learning.
